readme.text:
[English](README.md) · [中文](README.zh-CN.md)

> Turn a code flow into a **clickable diagram**, or a **long-form interactive explainer** — generated by your AI agent as a single offline HTML file.

CodeGraph is an Agent Skill for Claude Code, DeepSeek Harness, Cursor, Codex, and other Agent Skills-compatible agents. You describe the flow; the agent reads the code, builds the artifact, and keeps every element linked back to the source.
A normal diagram stops at the picture. CodeGraph keeps the connection to the code:

- **Click to source** — click a node, edge, sequence message, class, or relation to open the exact source line in your editor, or in an in-page panel.
- **Review with context** — point the agent at a PR, commit, or `base..head` range and added / modified / removed elements are highlighted in the graph.
- **Diagrams or a course** — use a flowchart, sequence diagram, or UML class diagram for structure; or switch to **CodeWalkthrough** for a scrollable explainer page with sections, inline visuals, source links, and an optional self-test.
Everything is generated as one self-contained HTML file. There is no server, CDN, or runtime `npm install` on the viewer's machine, and the artifact works offline.

**Review-mode flowchart.** Green is added, orange is modified, gray is unchanged. Clicking a node opens the referenced source line.

**Sequence diagram.** Same review colors, with actors, messages, and clickable source locations.

By default, keep one artifact focused on one question. When requested, a single
`graph.html` can combine one flowchart, one sequence diagram, and one class
diagram, each on its own tab. Duplicate diagram types are rejected.

readme.section: CodeWalkthrough: turn code into a course
readme.text:
CodeWalkthrough is not a summary of a file. It is a small course generated from
the codebase, built around three ideas:

readme.section: CodeWalkthrough: turn code into a course
readme.text:
- **Shallow to deep** — open with a one-paragraph mental model, then a
  big-picture diagram, a running example, the mechanisms, the boundaries, and a
  recap. Each section makes one point.
- **Visual first** — data flow, state transitions, and call chains become inline
  SVG/CSS/JS diagrams and animations. Code is an exhibit, not the main text.
- **Practice to verify** — an optional 3–5 question self-test, with multiple
  choice or click-to-reveal answers that explain why and link back to source.

readme.section: CodeWalkthrough: turn code into a course
readme.text:
One running example is reused across the page, and every key claim links to a
source line. The output is a single `walkthrough.html` that works offline.

Use it for onboarding, explaining a module, or turning a design review into a
reusable lesson.

```bash
claude plugin marketplace add longbowzz/CodeGraph
claude plugin install codegraph@codegraph
```

Inside a session, `/plugin install codegraph@codegraph --marketplace longbowzz/CodeGraph`
does both steps.

```bash
npx skills add longbowzz/CodeGraph --skill codegraph
```

Run it from the target project. Add `-g` to install globally, or
`-a claude-code` to skip the agent picker.

DSH profiles are isolated, and the Desktop app's `desktop` profile is managed by
the Electron application — the `dsh plugin --profile desktop …` command is
rejected. Use the install path that matches how you run DSH:

**Desktop app:** open **Plugins** in the sidebar, choose **Add plugin**, enter
`@longbowzz/dsh-codegraph@0.4.0`, install it, and enable the bundle if prompted.

**Web / CLI profiles** (`dsh web` uses the `web` profile):

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add -w @longbowzz/dsh-codegraph
```

`--profile web` only affects `dsh web`; it does **not** add the plugin to the
Desktop app. If you boot a different CLI-managed profile, replace `web` with
that profile name.

The `-w` flag adds the bundle to the profile's workspace root; pnpm requires it
on some DSH builds. After installing, **quit and reopen DSH** and start a new
session — bundles and client tabs load at boot.

Verify a CLI-managed profile contains the bundle:

```bash
cat ~/.dsh/profiles/web/package.json
```

`dependencies` and `dsh.profile.bundles` should both include
`@longbowzz/dsh-codegraph`.

The bundle adds the `codegraph_build`, `codegraph_walkthrough_build`, and
`codegraph_list` tools, result cards, and a right-sidebar graph/walkthrough tab.
See [`dsh/README.md`](dsh/README.md).

- **Node.js 18+** for the skill scripts. No runtime `npm install` is needed to
  generate or view artifacts.
- **Node.js 22.20+** for the `npx skills` CLI.
- A supported editor for click-to-source (VS Code, Cursor, JetBrains IDEs), or
  choose the **Web** editor to open source in an in-page panel.
- **DeepSeek Harness 0.2.x** for the DSH bundle.

Just talk to your agent in the repository you want to analyze:

> Use CodeGraph to draw the login flow as a sequence diagram.

> Use CodeGraph to draw the class model of the payment module.

> Combine a class diagram and a sequence diagram for this module.

> Review PR #123 with CodeGraph — highlight what changed.

> Use CodeGraph to explain the refund flow as an interactive webpage.

The first run may ask which editor to use. Choose **Web** if you do not have a
supported editor installed.

The result is written under `.codegraph/output/` in the target repository. In
DSH, a result card opens the graph or walkthrough in the right sidebar; in other
agents, open the reported HTML file in a browser.

- The agent writes the Mermaid text and the source-location table; the validator
  checks syntax, structure, paths, and line ranges. It cannot prove that a label
  matches the business meaning — the agent reads the code for that.
- Review colors: **green = added**, **orange = modified**, **gray = unchanged**.
- Artifacts are snapshots of the current checkout. Rebuild after the code moves.
- One artifact normally answers one question; combined pages support at most one
  flowchart, one sequence diagram, and one class diagram.
- Class entries may include optional `stereotype` and `summary` metadata; they
  power the hover card but are not required for click-to-source.
- CodeWalkthrough asks a few intake questions first; the self-test is optional
  and must be requested.
- In DSH, the analyzed repository must stay inside the session workspace.
- CodeGraph is not a generic “draw a diagram” trigger. Mention CodeGraph (or ask
  for a CodeWalkthrough) so the skill activates.

- [Agent contract](skills/codegraph/SKILL.md) — the full graph workflow and supported Mermaid subset.
- [CodeWalkthrough contract](skills/codegraph/references/walkthrough.md) — intake, structure, and self-check.
- [DeepSeek Harness bundle](dsh/README.md) — tools, cards, tabs, and configuration.
- [Class diagram example](skills/codegraph/examples/class-diagram/) — CodeGraph's own pipeline as a UML class diagram.
- [Example CodeWalkthrough body](skills/codegraph/examples/walkthrough-sample.html).
- Found a bug or have an idea? [Open an issue](https://github.com/longbowzz/CodeGraph/issues).

```bash
npm test          # parser, validator, diff, HTML build, CLI
npm run build:mermaid
```

Browser suites require Playwright and Chromium; see
[`skills/codegraph/scripts`](skills/codegraph/scripts) for the entry points.

Maintainers: see [RELEASING.md](RELEASING.md) for the version bump, publish, and release checklist.

[English](README.md) · [中文](README.zh-CN.md)

> 把一段代码流程变成**可点击的图**，或一篇**可交互的长文讲解**——由 AI Agent 生成，产物是单个离线 HTML 文件。

CodeGraph 是一个 Agent Skill，适用于 Claude Code、DeepSeek Harness、Cursor、Codex 等兼容 Agent Skills 的工具。你只需描述流程，Agent 会阅读代码、生成产物，并让每个元素都能跳回源码。

普通 Mermaid 图到“一张图”就结束了。CodeGraph 保留了图和代码之间的连接：

- **点击跳源码**——点节点、边、时序消息、类或关系，直接打开对应源码行；可以在编辑器里打开，也可以在页内面板查看。
- **带上下文 review**——把 PR、commit 或 `base..head` 范围交给 Agent，图里会用颜色标出新增 / 修改 / 删除的元素。
- **图表或课程**——用流程图、时序图或 UML 类图看结构；要讲清楚一个模块，就用 **CodeWalkthrough** 生成可滚动的长文讲解页，带小节、内联图、源码链接和可选自测。

所有内容都会打包成一个自包含 HTML：不需要服务器、CDN，查看端也不需要 `npm install`，离线可用。

**Review 模式流程图。** 绿色为新增，橙色为修改，灰色为未变；点击节点会打开对应源码行。

**时序图。** 同样的 review 配色，包含参与者、消息和可点击的源码位置。

让 Agent 画一个流程或建立类模型，它会生成单个 `graph.html`：

- 流程图、时序图或 UML 类图；
- 缩放、平移、hover 和点击跳源码；
- PR / commit / diff 的 review 模式；
- 任意浏览器可用，离线也能看。

**类图**展示类、字段、方法和 UML 关系。hover 一个类可以看到它的 stereotype
和职责，其余节点会变淡，只保留直接邻居；点击类或关系线可以打开源码。

默认建议一个 artifact 只回答一个问题。如果用户明确要求，一个 `graph.html`
可以同时包含一张流程图、一张时序图和一张类图，各自一个 tab；重复的图类型会被拒绝。

CodeWalkthrough 不是“总结一下这个文件”。它会基于代码生成一门小课，设计上围绕三件事：

- **由浅入深**——先用一段话建立心智模型，再给全局图，然后是一个贯穿全文的真实例子，最后进入机制、边界和回顾；每个小节只讲一件事。
- **图形化讲解**——数据流、状态变化、调用链用内联 SVG/CSS/JS 图和动画表达；代码是展品，不是正文。
- **练习题验证**——可选的 3–5 道自测题，支持选项判分或点击查看答案；答案解释原因，并链接回源码。

整篇只用一个贯穿案例，关键结论都带源码链接。产物是单个 `walkthrough.html`，离线可看。

适合 onboarding、模块讲解、设计评审，或把一次 review 变成可复用的教材。

```bash
claude plugin marketplace add longbowzz/CodeGraph
claude plugin install codegraph@codegraph
```

在会话里也可以用 `/plugin install codegraph@codegraph --marketplace longbowzz/CodeGraph`
一步完成。

readme.section: 任意兼容 Agent Skills 的 Agent
readme.text:
```bash
npx skills add longbowzz/CodeGraph --skill codegraph
```

在目标项目里运行。加 `-g` 安装到全局，加 `-a claude-code` 跳过 Agent 选择。

DSH 的 profile 是相互隔离的；桌面 App 的 `desktop` profile 由 Electron
应用管理，`dsh plugin --profile desktop …` 会被拒绝。请按你的运行方式安装：

**桌面 App**：在侧栏打开 **插件**，选择 **添加插件**，输入
`@longbowzz/dsh-codegraph@0.4.0`，安装；如果提示启用 bundle，选择启用。

**Web / CLI profile**（`dsh web` 使用 `web` profile）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add -w @longbowzz/dsh-codegraph
```

`--profile web` 只影响 `dsh web`，**不会**把插件加到桌面 App。如果启动的是
其他 CLI 管理的 profile，把 `web` 换成对应名字。

`-w` 会把依赖加到 profile 的 workspace root；部分 DSH 构建下 pnpm 要求显式指定。安装后需要**完全退出并重新打开 DSH**，再新建会话——bundle 和客户端 tab 在启动时加载。

可以检查 CLI profile 是否包含 bundle：

```bash
cat ~/.dsh/profiles/web/package.json
```

`dependencies` 和 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里都应该有 `@longbowzz/dsh-codegraph`。

这个 bundle 还会注册 `codegraph_build`、`codegraph_walkthrough_build`、`codegraph_list` 三个工具，以及结果卡片和右侧栏的图 / 讲解页 tab。详见 [`dsh/README.md`](dsh/README.md)。

- **Node.js 18+**：运行 Skill 脚本；生成和查看产物不需要运行时 `npm install`。
- **Node.js 22.20+**：使用 `npx skills` CLI 时需要。
- 点击跳源码需要受支持的编辑器（VS Code、Cursor、JetBrains 系列）；没有的话选 **Web** 编辑器，在页内面板打开源码。
- **DeepSeek Harness 0.2.x**：使用 DSH bundle 时。

在要分析的项目里直接对 Agent 说：

> 用 CodeGraph 画一下登录流程的时序图。

> 用 CodeGraph 画出支付模块的类图。

> 把这个模块的类图和时序图合并到一张页面里。

> 用 CodeGraph review 一下 PR #123，标出改动。

> 用 CodeGraph 为我介绍退款流程，做成一个可交互的网页。

第一次运行可能会问用哪个编辑器。没有安装受支持的编辑器时选 **Web**。

产物会写到目标项目的 `.codegraph/output/` 下。在 DSH 中，结果卡片会在右侧栏打开图或讲解页；其他 Agent 里直接打开它报告的 HTML 文件即可。

- Agent 负责写 Mermaid 文本和源码位置表；校验器检查语法、结构、路径和行号，但不能证明标签的业务含义正确——这需要 Agent 阅读代码来保证。
- Review 配色：**绿色 = 新增**，**橙色 = 修改**，**灰色 = 未变**。
- 产物是当前 checkout 的快照；代码改动后需要重新生成。
- 默认建议一个 artifact 只回答一个问题；合并页面最多包含一张流程图、一张时序图和一张类图。
- 类条目可以带可选的 `stereotype` / `summary` 元数据；它们用于 hover 卡片，不是点击跳转的必填项。
- CodeWalkthrough 会先确认读者、范围和深度；自测题是可选项，需要明确要求。
- 在 DSH 中，被分析的仓库必须位于 session workspace 内。
- CodeGraph 不是通用的“画个图”触发器。请明确提到 CodeGraph，或要求 CodeWalkthrough，Skill 才会激活。

- [Agent 规范](skills/codegraph/SKILL.md)——完整的画图流程和支持的 Mermaid 子集。
- [CodeWalkthrough 规范](skills/codegraph/references/walkthrough.md)——信息确认、页面结构和自检。
- [DeepSeek Harness 插件包](dsh/README.md)——工具、卡片、标签页和配置。
- [类图示例](skills/codegraph/examples/class-diagram/)——把 CodeGraph 自己的构建管线画成 UML 类图。
- [CodeWalkthrough 示例内容](skills/codegraph/examples/walkthrough-sample.html)。
- 有问题或建议？[提 Issue](https://github.com/longbowzz/CodeGraph/issues)。

```bash
npm test          # parser、validator、diff、HTML 构建、CLI
npm run build:mermaid
```

浏览器测试需要 Playwright 和 Chromium；入口脚本见
[`skills/codegraph/scripts`](skills/codegraph/scripts)。

维护者发版流程见 [RELEASING.md](RELEASING.md)。
MIT。见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。
